Rule XXII Standing Rules of the Senate

effect of joint resolution of disapproval

events.text: Secretary of Commerce designates a foreign government or regime as a foreign adversary
Secretary of Commerce removes a foreign adversary designation for a foreign government or regime
A covered joint resolution is introduced within 60-calendar days after the Secretary designates or removes a foreign adversary designation
House committee is discharged if it has not reported a covered joint resolution within 10 legislative days after referral
Senate committee is discharged if it has not reported a covered joint resolution within 10 session days after referral
House consideration begins on the third legislative day after committee reports or is discharged
events.date_hint: third legislative day after reporting or discharge

events.text: Senate vote on passage occurs immediately following conclusion of debate
Senate debate on a covered joint resolution is limited to not more than 10 hours
Senate debate on any veto message with respect to a covered joint resolution is limited to 10 hours
